description: Use when an agent checks a Hyperliquid account: its own risk, a whale or a copy-trade target. Input: address (0x...), optional orders (0-50). Output: JSON account value, positions with leverage, PnL, liquidation price and distance, cross margin ratio, riskLevel, net exposure, spot balances, open orders, last-24h fills and realized PnL. Cached 10 s. Example: ?address=0x5b5d51203a0f9079f8aeb098a6523a13f298c060 Price: $0.005 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: Hyperliquid account (EVM) address. Malformed: 400 before payment (not charged)

orders.description: Largest open orders to list (0-50, default 10); the count and total are always returned

name: hl_wallet
title: Hyperliquid wallet positions and liquidation risk: perps, leverage, liquidation distance, margin ratio, open orders, 24h fills
